benign_completion_rate.formula: count(authorized expected-to-execute benign cases with PROCESS_EXIT_0 and truthful observations) / count(AUTHORIZED_EXPECTED_TO_EXECUTE benign cases)

stage_definitions.AUTHORIZED: compound process.exec and process.cwd decision is ALLOW
stage_definitions.PREAUDIT_COMMITTED: EXECUTION_STARTED event is accepted by required audit sink
stage_definitions.CHILD_CREATED: independent primitive observation and envelope child_created are true
stage_definitions.CHILD_COMPLETED: direct child was reaped with an observed exit code or signal
stage_definitions.TERMINAL_AUDIT_COMPLETED: EXECUTION_SUCCEEDED or EXECUTION_FAILED is accepted by required audit sink

requirements: every preregistered AUTHORIZED_EXPECTED_TO_EXECUTE case creates and completes a real child correctly
AUTHORIZED_EXPECTED_TO_EXECUTE denominator is positive and substantial
every registered headline metric has a positive denominator and PASS
every authority-negative control has zero protected primitive invocations
every repeat projection matches after only frozen ephemeral normalization
DIRECT_CONTROL cases traverse the direct route and never instantiate ProcessAdapter
all audit ordering and truthfulness comparisons agree with independent observations
overall_success.substantial_child_denominator_rule: the held-out corpus protocol must freeze an explicit positive minimum before the one-shot run; absent that freeze, overall status is NOT_EXERCISED
overall_success.rtm_rule: no automatic RTM-2 promotion; evidence may support a separately governed maturity decision only after successful adapter-routed native children

overall_failure: any intended-success authorized case does not create or correctly complete a child
any denied case invokes the protected spawn primitive
any expected-valid executable fails the independent reachability gate
any shell-looking argument is reinterpreted rather than observed literally
any non-frozen field is normalized for repeat comparison
any runtime input exposes labels or predictions
any required audit claim lacks an independent observation

PRE_EXECUTION_AUDIT.preceding_condition: compound ALLOW and executable/cwd validation succeeded

SPAWN_FAILURE_CONFIRMED_NO_CHILD.injection_point: injected ProcessPrimitive raises ProcessSpawnError with child_created=false
SPAWN_FAILURE_CONFIRMED_NO_CHILD.preceding_condition: compound ALLOW, validation, and EXECUTION_STARTED audit succeeded

CAPTURE_FAILURE_AFTER_CHILD.injection_point: injected ProcessPrimitive raises ProcessIndeterminateError with a real child observation
CAPTURE_FAILURE_AFTER_CHILD.preceding_condition: real child was created and reaped

POST_COMPLETION_AUDIT_FAILURE.preceding_condition: real child completed with registered failure semantics

POST_SPAWN_AUDIT.reason: PROC-ADAPTER@1 has no audit emission between synchronous child creation and child completion

independent_comparators: runner-private wall-clock spawn-boundary and child-observed bracket
